terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.s1_body: By accessing or using MyFutureAbroad, you agree to be bound by these Terms & Conditions. If you do not agree, please do not use the platform.
terms.s2_body: MyFutureAbroad provides information and tools to assist individuals planning to move abroad. The platform is for personal, non-commercial use only. You must not misuse or abuse any features of the service.
terms.s3_body: We strive to keep visa and service information accurate, but we make no guarantees. Immigration rules change frequently — always verify details with official government sources before making decisions.
terms.s4_body: MyFutureAbroad links to third-party services (e.g. Trip.com, service providers). We are not responsible for the content, accuracy, or practices of those third parties.
terms.s5_body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, MyFutureAbroad shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the platform.
terms.s6_body: We may update these Terms from time to time. Continued use of the platform after changes constitutes acceptance of the new Terms.
terms.s7_body: For any questions about these Terms, please contact us via the Support page.

privacy.title: Privacy Notice
privacy.s1_body: MyFutureAbroad is a platform that helps individuals plan and manage their move abroad. References to "we", "us", or "our" refer to MyFutureAbroad.
privacy.s2_body: We collect information you provide when creating an account (name, email address) and data generated through your use of the platform (e.g. saved visas, checklists, documents, messages).
privacy.s3_body: Your data is used to provide and improve the MyFutureAbroad service, personalise your experience, and communicate with you about your account or bookings. We do not sell your personal data to third parties.
privacy.s4_body: Your data is stored securely using Supabase. We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your information.
privacy.s5_body: We use browser local storage to remember your preferences (e.g. theme, consent acknowledgement). No tracking cookies are placed on your device without consent.
privacy.s6_body: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data at any time. To exercise these rights, contact us via the Support page.
privacy.s7_body: We may update this Privacy Notice from time to time. We will notify you of significant changes via email or an in-app notice.
privacy.s8_body: For any privacy-related questions, please reach out via the Support page.
